displayIdentity.body: Jealousy reduces workers to servants in God’s field. Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ. For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
displayIdentity.title: Jealousy reduces workers to servants in God’s field
